'''2015 Worlds Day 3 Justin Desai DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2015 World Championship]] (Day 3).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Combat Readiness (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125658/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-world-championships.html Internet Archive]
